frontmatter.name: business-analyst
frontmatter.description: Looks at a task from the side of the product and its cost. Says what the owner gets, what it costs, what can be dropped without losing the goal and why it is worth doing now rather than in half a year. Use for large tasks before the work starts and for reviewing plans.

frontmatter.name: goal-critic
frontmatter.description: Compares the result with the owner's words and tries to prove the goal is not met. Takes neither the plan nor the session's account of the work as evidence. Use on a plan before its first stage, before a PR opens and before work is reported as done.

nodes.label: What is proved in each mode
nodes.norm_label: what is proved in each mode

frontmatter.name: product-strategist
frontmatter.description: Tries to prove that work misses its point and does not lead to the milestone of its epic. Reads the mission of the product, names where the product stands and what each task must change. Use while planning work and while reviewing done work.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch

nodes.label: What is proved in each mode
nodes.norm_label: what is proved in each mode

frontmatter.name: project-manager
frontmatter.description: Splits a task into steps with boundaries and risks, accepts the result against the original request, prepares tasks for the work queue and checks the work against the tree's rules. Use before a large edit and after it, not for one-line changes.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Write, Edit

frontmatter.name: conscience
frontmatter.description: Reads the incident reviews of this tree and the record of the current turn and names the miss that repeats in it. Edits no files, preaches nothing. Use at the end of a turn, on a guard refusal and after a miss has been admitted.

frontmatter.name: prose-editor
frontmatter.description: Rewrites a paragraph refused by the prose check in plain words without changing the meaning. Returns the rewritten text and a list of what was changed. Use when the prose guard refused an edit.

frontmatter.name: rules-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Reads a family of rules-layer texts in full — a law, all rules under it and all patterns next to them. Looks for what no machine counts, two texts saying different things about one matter and a case no text named. Edits no files. Use before a new package edition and after editing a law or a rule.

frontmatter.name: spec-critic
frontmatter.description: Adversarially reviews a product agreement before code is written by it — looks for what is left unsaid, double readings and cases the spec did not name. Use right after spec-writer and before planning the implementation.

frontmatter.name: strict-teacher
frontmatter.description: Quizzes the executor on the content of the rules loaded in this session and gives a verdict — learned or not. Changes no files, asks the owner nothing. Use at session start before the first edit and before a PR leaves draft.

frontmatter.name: conscience
frontmatter.description: Reads the incident reviews of this tree and the record of the current turn and names the miss that repeats in it. Edits no files, preaches nothing. Use at the end of a turn, on a guard refusal and after a miss has been admitted.

frontmatter.name: prose-editor
frontmatter.description: Rewrites a paragraph refused by the prose check in plain words without changing the meaning. Returns the rewritten text and a list of what was changed. Use when the prose guard refused an edit.

frontmatter.name: rules-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Reads a family of rules-layer texts in full — a law, all rules under it and all patterns next to them. Looks for what no machine counts, two texts saying different things about one matter and a case no text named. Edits no files. Use before a new package edition and after editing a law or a rule.

frontmatter.name: spec-critic
frontmatter.description: Adversarially reviews a product agreement before code is written by it — looks for what is left unsaid, double readings and cases the spec did not name. Use right after spec-writer and before planning the implementation.

frontmatter.name: strict-teacher
frontmatter.description: Quizzes the executor on the content of the rules loaded in this session and gives a verdict — learned or not. Changes no files, asks the owner nothing. Use at session start before the first edit and before a PR leaves draft.
